findings: Released comparator has12XM devices and400nm lengths; fabricated comparator reconstruction has97 fingers with280nm lengths. They are not interchangeable measurement testbenches.
Comparator control file defines simulation clock1440ps and Monte Carlo-style loops, not laboratory operating settings for the submitted comparator.

amplifier_baseline_audit.released_amplifier_family: Programmable two-stage amplifier; NMOS input pair L1um, PMOS output L0.7um, single Miller branch and series resistor.
amplifier_baseline_audit.reconstructed_measured_candidate: opamp2_to_fix, complementary input pairs L0.3um, folded-cascode/classAB topology and two output-to-gate compensation branches.
amplifier_baseline_audit.conclusion: The released two-stage testbench is not the hybrid folded-cascode simulation baseline in Table1. Its bias/load settings cannot be transferred as measured hybrid-amplifier conditions.
amplifier_baseline_audit.implication: Vprog1V does not determine the separate external cascode voltages. Current sweeps are scenarios, not reconstruction of the measurement bias point.
amplifier_baseline_audit.scope: Pinned public tree and previously reconstructed metal connectivity; not an exhaustive claim about private files, other revisions or all online materials.
